PD.objective: minimise mean(peak_swing + 4 * residual_swing) [deg] over a held-out uncertainty design, subject to (i) every sample finite, (ii) the load arriving -- median |position error| over the last 5 s below 1.25 % of the transfer -- and (iii) the command using no more than SLEW_BUDGET of the drive's available slew rate on average
